claims.statement: For the fixed operational data declared below, establish the conjunction that (i) the two-sided contextual relation is the coarsest response-compatible congruence and its quotient has the terminal finer-to-coarser universal property and finite minimum cardinality over the raw quotient map; (ii) under compact-metrizable continuity and quotient-map hypotheses this quotient is compact metrizable with continuous multiplication and response; (iii) finite normalized typed local-kernel replacement supports a compact right-override soft protocol monoid and the retained mediator target face of the released BSC pair has unequal exact total-variation diameters despite the same passive law; (iv) independent randomized hard protocols form an affine convolution monoid whose released BSC contextual signatures have full rank, so equal passive laws do not determine the randomized response experiment under response-compatible affine unital convolution-monoid isomorphism; (v) declared finite standard-Borel DAG kernels give Borel protocol responses and the compact-Polish jointly Feller right-override tier gives a compact metrizable operational quotient; and (vi) in the category that fixes the mediator parameter experiment and circle heat geometry, the circle heat-kernel pair has the same passive retained law but strict one-way Blackwell comparison and strict soft response-set inclusion. No canonical raw latent/DAG realization, target-erasing arbitrary-soft result, correlated-randomization result, uncontrolled regular-conditional identification, noncompact topological quotient theorem, VFE/ELBO emergence, agency, gauge/RG extension, or ontology claim is in the target.
claims.quantifiers: For every monoid A, response set Y, and response map Phi:A->Y, the algebraic contextual-quotient conjunct is universal. For every compact metrizable monoid A with jointly continuous multiplication, metrizable Hausdorff Y, and continuous Phi, and every continuous response-compatible quotient triple (q,B,psi) whose surjection q is a quotient map, the compact-quotient conjunct is universal. For every finite DAG presentation with finite state spaces and declared compact typed palettes of normalized local replacement kernels, the normalized soft-replacement semantics is universal; the unequal target-face diameters are asserted for the specified BSC models L(1/4,1/3) and L(1/3,1/4), every epsilon with 0<epsilon<1/2, and every interior pair epsilon<s_-<s_+<1-epsilon. For the released fifteen-class hard BSC monoids and independently randomized selectors, the affine-convolution and full-contextual-rank conjunct is asserted at passive crossover delta=5/12 under response-compatible affine unital convolution-monoid isomorphisms. For every finite standard-Borel DAG with standard-Borel protocol palettes and declared jointly evaluation-measurable normalized pointwise kernel families, the Borel-response conjunct is universal; for every compact-Polish jointly Feller instance whose protocol monoid is the finite right-override product of compact metrizable palettes and isolated bottom symbols, the compact operational quotient conjunct is universal. For the circle heat-kernel models and every 0<s<t, the passive-equality, strict one-way Blackwell, and strict soft-response-set conjunct is universal in s and t, with a positive smooth strictness witness for every 0<rho<t-s. Every experiment comparison preserves the declared target/type coloring, response codomain, mediator parameter experiment, circle heat geometry where applicable, and admitted morphism class.
claims.falsifier: A counterexample within any conjunct's frozen hypotheses or a failure of a required factorization, normalization, measurability, continuity, response-intertwining, or target-preservation condition.
